name: Animated Text Buttons
description: Row of three pill buttons whose letters animate one by one on hover: a jumping bounce, a smoke blur-out, and a skewed drive-by.
contents: Three pill buttons with per-letter spans: jumping, smoke and drive hover styles
behavior: On hover each letter plays a staggered keyframe animation
Buttons lift and gain a stronger shadow on hover
Layout stacks vertically on small screens and sits in a row from sm up
editableByProps: Button labels, background and text colors, font size and letter spacing

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the number of buttons or their hover effects
needsCodeEdit.where: The three button elements and the move, smoke and drive keyframes in the style block
The box-shadow classes on each button

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Button shadow colors are hardcoded in the classes
Keyframes move, smoke and drive are injected as global CSS
